summary: PM collect_work always fetch_ready_issue_candidates (not only nested in what_next); ready search includes Documentation; avoids process-only queue when implementable issues exist under pm_tick/pm_propose_run priorities (#660/#654).
migration_impact: PM cycles may propose Documentation and Feature/Bug ready rows even when what_next priority is pm_tick or pm_propose_run. Empty-ready repos still fall back to process what_next blob.
migration_guidance: 2. Ensure implementable work has Feature/Bug/Documentation labels without need:refinement/status:stub.
3. plate_pm_run_cycle dry_run should list issue-N rows when such issues are open.
agent_notes: fetch_ready_issue_candidates fallback query now includes label:Documentation. collect_work dedupes by issue number across direct fetch + what_next expansion.
